initialPrompt: help me answer this customer's security questionnaire

design.independentReview: Separate source and output inspection by a reviewer with case and guide access; no blind scoring or new performer call.
design.claims: Both drafts are factually sound. Observed handoff-detail and review-burden differences do not establish a factual or aggregate quality lift.

runtime.binaryIdentityEvidence: Recorded native host preflight for the desktop binary used by the runner.
runtime.authentication: Existing ChatGPT authentication; no API-key fallback, new credentials, purchase or reset.
runtime.deliverySurface: Native app-server with local candidate MCP fixture; marketplace plugin installation was not tested.
runtime.isolation: Separate synthetic writable workspaces; personal connectors and plugins disabled; shell network disabled.
runtime.sharedInstructionCaveat: Both arms inherited the same global workflow preferences, including browser/PR preferences. Personal instruction/configuration files are omitted from this bundle.
runtime.runtimeReproducibilityLimit: Full native logs, private configuration and controller source files are excluded. Frozen campaign controller hashes are supplied as provenance, without a self-contained runtime replay.

limits.reactiveMonitoring: Token/quota telemetry and interruption were reactive, not a hard in-flight billing cap.
limits.accountTelemetry: Missing numeric balance observations occurred; observed numeric balances did not decrease. Shared-account activity, gaps and delayed billing prevent complete attribution. Account identifiers, numeric balances and actual account-usage percentages are omitted.

factualFollowups.actualQuestion: Are there approved deletion and vulnerability remediation deadlines beyond the unsigned draft? It proposes deletion within 30 days and triage within two working days, but neither is an approved commitment in the supplied records.
factualFollowups.scope: Approved deletion and vulnerability remediation deadlines.
factualFollowups.sourcePolicy: Frozen operator answer packet: unknownAnswer when the supplied sources contain no answer. No new facts, computed answers or approvals were supplied.

factualFollowups.actualQuestion:
I found the 10-question form and supporting records. Is there newer approved evidence for encryption coverage, restore tests, deletion timing, or vulnerability remediation, or a customer-specific contract clause I should use?
- Use the supplied records and flag gaps
- I have newer evidence or contract details
factualFollowups.scope: Newer approved evidence and customer-specific contract clauses.
factualFollowups.sourcePolicy: Frozen operator answer packet: unknownAnswer when the supplied sources contain no answer. No new facts, computed answers or approvals were supplied.

contextReadOutcome.summary: One synthetic company; no saved runs, records or updates. No open_process or save_update call occurred.

result: Both preserved the form and supplied supported answers with explicit unknowns. UM adds proposed reviewer routing, disclosure boundaries and portal qualification handling while flagging more rows for review. No substantive guide-correctness fix is supported by this case alone.
limitations: One author-visible synthetic, control-first case; no independent holdout or aggregate causal comparison.
The reviewer saw the case and guide, and the control was inspected before the UM match.
Both arms completed local drafts. Customer portal compatibility, approval, evidence disclosure, submission, customer acceptance and actual control operation were not tested.
UM returned no saved runs, records or updates and made no open_process or save_update call. Cross-agent memory benefit remains untested.
The local candidate MCP fixture does not establish marketplace installation or current production visibility.
UM used more gross and uncached input tokens and slightly more elapsed time in this case. Gross tokens are not monetary cost.
Additional flags can improve a handoff but also increase reviewer burden; flag count is not an error count.
redactionNotes: Raw fictional source files and performer output files under arms/ are byte-identical; no redactions were necessary. Original CSV newline bytes are preserved.

Conversation internal item IDs are omitted; absolute user output-link prefixes and workspace-relative output links are replaced with bundle-relative arm paths. Message wording and order are otherwise preserved.

Metadata and reports are curated derivatives. Full native logs, personal configuration/instructions, account/organization/thread IDs, numeric credit balances, credentials and private endpoint addresses are excluded.
Independent report links are rebased to this bundle. The independent checks file is copied byte-for-byte from the local review.
